vocab_words.example: Defective items are returned to the manufacturer.
We switched to a more reliable supplier.

vocab_words.meaning: hậu cần, công tác vận chuyển
vocab_words.example: The logistics team coordinates all deliveries.
The factory upgraded its assembly line last year.
The company plans to upgrade its software system.
A malfunction caused the server to shut down.
All data is protected by strong encryption.
The technician helped troubleshoot the network issue.
The new printer is compatible with most devices.
Customer records are stored in a secure database.

items.question: The company's revenue ___ substantially since the merger.
items.explanation: "Since + mốc thời gian" đi cùng thì hiện tại hoàn thành.

items.question: The client was pleased ___ the quality of the final product.
items.explanation: Cụm cố định "be pleased with something".

items.question: The company offers a ___ range of products to suit different needs.
items.explanation: Cần tính từ "wide" để bổ nghĩa cho danh từ "range".

items.question: Our supplier can deliver the goods ___ two business days.
items.explanation: "Within" dùng để chỉ khoảng thời gian giới hạn (trong vòng).

items.question: The document must be reviewed carefully ___ submitting it.
items.explanation: Ngữ cảnh cần trước khi nộp thì phải xem lại tài liệu, dùng "before".

items.question: The client requested that the invoice ___ sent by email.
items.explanation: Câu giả định (subjunctive) sau "request that" dùng động từ nguyên mẫu "be".

items.question: The new software update improves the system's ___ significantly.
items.explanation: Cần danh từ (noun) sau tính từ sở hữu "the system's".

items.question: It is essential that all staff ___ the new safety guidelines.
items.explanation: Câu giả định sau "it is essential that" dùng động từ nguyên mẫu.

items.question: The report contains ___ information than we expected.
items.explanation: So sánh hơn với danh từ không đếm được "information" dùng "more".

items.question: The company's profits have grown steadily ___ the past five years.
items.explanation: "Over the past + khoảng thời gian" diễn tả một quá trình kéo dài.
